Apply Student Withdrawals to a Class List

Source: R/withdrawing.R
apply_withdrawal.Rd

Matches withdrawal requests to students in a class list and updates their withdrawal status. Supports both legacy school-name/date-of-birth matching and current establishment-identifier matching.

Usage

apply_withdrawal(
  class_list,
  withdrawn_students,
  school_dob_match = FALSE,
  legacy_school_link = "~/Wonde/Establishment_List_ID.xlsx",
  links_category = "Primary",
  expected_years = c(2019, 2020),
  do_log = FALSE,
  reference_school_name_column = "EstablishmentName",
  reference_school_id_column = "URN",
  keep_grep = paste0("I want to withdraw my child from the study|",
    "No, please delete any previous data about my child"),
  TypeOfWithdrawalColumn = "Type of withdrawal",
  FirstNameColumn = "Your child's first name",
  LastNameColumn = "Your child's surname",
  EstablishmentIDColumn = "EstablishmentID",
  school_id_column = "est_id",
  ...
)

Arguments

class_list

A data frame containing student records. Columns may use the configured or internal naming convention.

withdrawn_students

A data frame containing withdrawal responses, or a path to an XLSX file.

school_dob_match

Logical. If TRUE, use the legacy school-name and date-of-birth matching method. If FALSE, use the establishment-identifier matching method.

legacy_school_link

Path to the external school reference XLSX file used by the legacy matching method.

links_category

School category, retained for compatibility with the legacy method. Filtering is not currently applied.

expected_years

Numeric vector of acceptable birth years used by the legacy date-of-birth processing function.

do_log

Logical. Whether to write a log when using the legacy matching method.

reference_school_name_column

Column containing school names in the external school reference file. Used only by the legacy method. Defaults to "EstablishmentName".

reference_school_id_column

Column containing school identifiers in the external reference file. Used only by the legacy method. Defaults to "URN". Values must match the class list's configured `urn` column.

keep_grep

Regular expression identifying withdrawal responses to retain. Used by the current method.

TypeOfWithdrawalColumn

Column containing the type of withdrawal in the withdrawal form.

FirstNameColumn

Column containing the student's first name in the withdrawal form.

LastNameColumn

Column containing the student's surname in the withdrawal form.

EstablishmentIDColumn

Column containing the school identifier in the withdrawal form.

school_id_column

Internal or configured column name identifying the school in the class list for the current matching method. Defaults to "est_id".

...

Additional arguments passed to the selected internal withdrawal function.

Value

A list containing:

class_list

Updated class list using configured column names, with matched students marked as withdrawn.

withdraw

Withdrawal matching report containing MatchDetail, SchoolCheck, CLASS_LIST_INDEX, matchedFirstName, matchedLastName, matchedSchoolName, and IGNORE_RESULT.

Details

When `school_dob_match = TRUE`, the function calls `.apply_withdrawal_old()`. This matches school names against an external reference file and uses student names and dates of birth to identify withdrawals.

When `school_dob_match = FALSE`, the function calls `.apply_withdrawal_new()`. This matches students using an establishment identifier and student names.

Both methods preserve existing withdrawal statuses and create the configured withdrawal column if it is missing. Only uniquely matched students are marked as withdrawn.

The function does not require a Wonde student identifier. It marks withdrawals but does not automatically remove identifying information. Use `clear_withdrawn_student_data()` separately for that purpose.

See also

Other withdrawing: clear_withdrawn_student_data(), revert_ignored_withdrawals()
